description: Use for "why are visitors from my Meta ads not adding to cart, not checking out or not buying?". Returns the stage strip from visit to product, add to cart, checkout and purchase (with counts, or "not visible" when we cannot see that step yet), the biggest drop against the e-commerce benchmark, and the likely causes ranked by buyers lost (about), each with its stage, how likely it is (high, medium, low), what we saw with the numbers, the likely cause, 2 to 4 fix steps and what would confirm it. Covers traffic and targeting, ad to page promise, technical problems (in app browser, speed, pop ups, failed adds, sold out products, the Pixel), the product page, cart and checkout friction, measurement gaps and the Meta account. Also lists what we cannot see yet and how to see it (for example the optional Shopify checkout pixel). Same as the app's "Why visitors are not buying". Saved data from the daily visitor review, computed on demand when missing.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.
